summary.text: David Dillie is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 161 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Bill Hitchens.
His Ballotpedia profile lists his profession as construction, and his survey response describes him as an aircraft mechanic at Gulfstream.

paragraphs.text: David Dillie's Ballotpedia survey response says he comes from a long line of farmers and works as an aircraft mechanic at Gulfstream.
It also describes him as an AWS-certified welder, pipefitter and plumber who is studying Construction Management.
Dillie advanced from the Democratic primary for District 161 on May 19, 2026.
In the survey, he named environmental policy as the area of public policy he is most passionate about and listed support for working families and a cleaner Georgia among his campaign messages.
